<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="390" height="844" viewBox="0 0 390 844">
  <defs>
    <linearGradient id="tinderGradient" x1="0%" y1="0%" x2="100%" y2="100%">
      <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#FE3675"/>
      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#FF7854"/>
    </linearGradient>
    <filter id="shadow" x="-20%" y="-20%" width="140%" height="150%">
      <feGaussianBlur in="SourceAlpha" stdDeviation="3"/>
      <feOffset dy="2"/>
      <feComponentTransfer>
        <feFuncA type=" linear" slope="0.12"/>
      </feComponentTransfer>
      <feMerge>
        <feMergeNode/>
        <feMergeNode in="SourceGraphic"/>
      </feMerge>
    </filter>
  </defs>

  <rect x="0" y="0" width="390" height="844" fill="#F5F7FA"/>

  <!-- Status bar -->
  <rect x="0" y="0" width="390" height="28" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
  <text x="22" y="19" font-family="Gotham, sans-serif" font-size="12" font-weight="bold" fill="#000000">9:41</text>
  <line x1="321" y1="17" x2="321" y2="11" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="2"/>
  <line x1="326" y1="17" x2="326" y2="9" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="2"/>
  <line x1="331" y1="17" x2="331" y2="7" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="2"/>
  <circle cx="346" cy="13" r="3" fill="none" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <line x1="348" y1="15" x2="351" y2="18" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <rect x="360" y="8" width="21" height="11" rx="2" fill="none" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <rect x="382" y="11" width="2" height="5" rx="1" fill="#000000"/>
  <rect x="362" y="10" width="16" height="7" rx="1" fill="#000000"/>

  <!-- Header -->
  <rect x="0" y="28" width="390" height="89" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
  <text x="22" y="67" font-family="Gotham, sans-serif" font-size="26" font-weight="bold" fill="#4A4A4A">Messages</text>
  <text x="22" y="91" font-family="Gotham, sans-serif" font-size="12" font-weight="normal" fill="#939393">Keep the conversation going</text>
  <g>
    <circle cx="355" cy="67" r="21" fill="#F5F7FA"/>
    <circle cx="351" cy="64" r="6" fill="none" stroke="#4A4A4A" stroke-width="2"/>
    <line x1="355.5" y1="68.5" x2="362" y2="75" stroke="#4A4A4A" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  </g>
  <line x1="20" y1="116" x2="370" y2="116" stroke="#EAEDF1" stroke-width="1"/>

  <!-- Search -->
  <g>
    <rect x="20" y="130" width="350" height="43" rx="21.5" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#EAEDF1" stroke-width="1"/>
    <circle cx="42" cy="150" r="7" fill="none" stroke="#939393" stroke-width="1.8"/>
    <line x1="47" y1="155" x2="52" y2="160" stroke="#939393" stroke-width="1.8" stroke-linecap="round"/>
    <text x="64" y="155" font-family="Gotham, sans-serif" font-size="14" fill="#939393">Search messages</text>
  </g>

  <!-- Section heading -->
  <text x="22" y="201" font-family="Gotham, sans-serif" font-size="16" font-weight="bold" fill="#4A4A4A">Your matches</text>
  <text x="319" y="201" font-family="Gotham, sans-serif" font-size="12" font-weight="bold" fill="#FE3675">See all</text>

  <!-- Conversation 1 -->
  <g filter="url(#shadow)">
    <rect x="20" y="217" width="350" height="82" rx="12" fill="#D9D9D9" opacity="0.28"/>
    <rect x="20" y="215" width="350" height="82" rx="12" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
  </g>
  <circle cx="61" cy="256" r="27" fill="#EA5D6B"/>
  <text x="61" y="262" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Gotham, sans-serif" font-size="18" font-weight="bold" fill="#FFFFFF">AM</text>
  <circle cx="80" cy="276" r="6" fill="#96E063" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="2"/>
  <text x="103" y="244" font-family="Gotham, sans-serif" font-size="15" font-weight="bold" fill="#4A4A4A">Avery Morgan</text>
  <text x="103" y="266" font-family="Gotham, sans-serif" font-size="13" fill="#939393">That coffee place sounds perfect ☕</text>
  <text x="103" y="284" font-family="Gotham, sans-serif" font-size="11" fill="#939393">Just now</text>
  <rect x="337" y="241" width="20" height="20" rx="10" fill="url(#tinderGradient)"/>
  <text x="347" y="255" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Gotham, sans-serif" font-size="11" font-weight="bold" fill="#FFFFFF">2</text>

  <!-- Conversation 2 -->
  <g>
    <rect x="20" y="308" width="350" height="82" rx="12" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
    <circle cx="61" cy="349" r="27" fill="#4396F7"/>
    <text x="61" y="355" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Gotham, sans-serif" font-size="18" font-weight="bold" fill="#FFFFFF">JL</text>
    <circle cx="80" cy="369" r="6" fill="#96E063" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="2"/>
    <text x="103" y="337" font-family="Gotham, sans-serif" font-size="15" font-weight="bold" fill="#4A4A4A">Jordan Lee</text>
    <text x="103" y="359" font-family="Gotham, sans-serif" font-size="13" fill="#4A4A4A">You: I’m always up for a good hike.</text>
    <text x="103" y="377" font-family="Gotham, sans-serif" font-size="11" fill="#939393">12 min ago</text>
    <rect x="331" y="333" width="27" height="18" rx="9" fill="#F2F2F6"/>
    <text x="344.5" y="346" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Gotham, sans-serif" font-size="10" font-weight="bold" fill="#939393">NEW</text>
  </g>
  <line x1="103" y1="390" x2="370" y2="390" stroke="#EAEDF1" stroke-width="1"/>

  <!-- Conversation 3 -->
  <g>
    <rect x="20" y="399" width="350" height="82" rx="12" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
    <circle cx="61" cy="440" r="27" fill="#EFC54D"/>
    <text x="61" y="446" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Gotham, sans-serif" font-size="18" font-weight="bold" fill="#FFFFFF">SR</text>
    <text x="103" y="428" font-family="Gotham, sans-serif" font-size="15" font-weight="bold" fill="#4A4A4A">Sofia Ramirez</text>
    <text x="103" y="450" font-family="Gotham, sans-serif" font-size="13" fill="#939393">Your travel photos are amazing!</text>
    <text x="103" y="468" font-family="Gotham, sans-serif" font-size="11" fill="#939393">Yesterday</text>
    <circle cx="347" cy="437" r="4" fill="#FE3675"/>
  </g>

  <!-- Conversation 4 -->
  <g>
    <rect x="20" y="490" width="350" height="82" rx="12" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
    <circle cx="61" cy="531" r="27" fill="#96E063"/>
    <text x="61" y="537" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Gotham, sans-serif" font-size="18" font-weight="bold" fill="#FFFFFF">NC</text>
    <text x="103" y="519" font-family="Gotham, sans-serif" font-size="15" font-weight="bold" fill="#4A4A4A">Noah Carter</text>
    <text x="103" y="541" font-family="Gotham, sans-serif" font-size="13" fill="#939393">Are you watching the game tonight?</text>
    <text x="103" y="559" font-family="Gotham, sans-serif" font-size="11" fill="#939393">Mon</text>
    <circle cx="347" cy="528" r="4" fill="#D9D9D9"/>
  </g>

  <!-- Conversation 5 -->
  <g>
    <rect x="20" y="581" width="350" height="82" rx="12" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
    <circle cx="61" cy="622" r="27" fill="#C42936"/>
    <text x="61" y="628" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Gotham, sans-serif" font-size="18" font-weight="bold" fill="#FFFFFF">EP</text>
    <text x="103" y="610" font-family="Gotham, sans-serif" font-size="15" font-weight="bold" fill="#4A4A4A">Ella Peterson</text>
    <text x="103" y="632" font-family="Gotham, sans-serif" font-size="13" fill="#939393">That playlist was such a good find.</text>
    <text x="103" y="650" font-family="Gotham, sans-serif" font-size="11" fill="#939393">Sun</text>
    <circle cx="347" cy="619" r="4" fill="#D9D9D9"/>
  </g>

  <!-- Conversation 6 -->
  <g>
    <rect x="20" y="672" width="350" height="74" rx="12" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
    <circle cx="61" cy="709" r="27" fill="#7D8490"/>
    <text x="61" y="715" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Gotham, sans-serif" font-size="18" font-weight="bold" fill="#FFFFFF">DK</text>
    <text x="103" y="697" font-family="Gotham, sans-serif" font-size="15" font-weight="bold" fill="#4A4A4A">Dylan Kim</text>
    <text x="103" y="719" font-family="Gotham, sans-serif" font-size="13" fill="#939393">Let’s compare favorite restaurants.</text>
    <text x="103" y="737" font-family="Gotham, sans-serif" font-size="11" fill="#939393">Sat</text>
  </g>

  <!-- Bottom navigation -->
  <rect x="0" y="767" width="390" height="77" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
  <line x1="0" y1="767" x2="390" y2="767" stroke="#EAEDF1" stroke-width="1"/>

  <!-- Home -->
  <g>
    <polygon points="39,790 50,781 61,790" fill="none" stroke="#939393" stroke-width="2"/>
    <rect x="43" y="789" width="14" height="12" fill="none" stroke="#939393" stroke-width="2"/>
    <text x="50" y="824" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Gotham, sans-serif" font-size="10" fill="#939393">Home</text>
  </g>

  <!-- Explore -->
  <g>
    <circle cx="128" cy="791" r="10" fill="none" stroke="#939393" stroke-width="2"/>
    <polygon points="132,786 129,794 121,797 124,789" fill="#939393"/>
    <text x="128" y="824" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Gotham, sans-serif" font-size="10" fill="#939393">Explore</text>
  </g>

  <!-- Messages selected -->
  <g>
    <rect x="184" y="780" width="27" height="20" rx="6" fill="url(#tinderGradient)"/>
    <polygon points="190,800 194,800 191,805" fill="#FE3675"/>
    <line x1="191" y1="787" x2="204" y2="787" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <line x1="191" y1="792" x2="201" y2="792" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <text x="198" y="824" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Gotham, sans-serif" font-size="10" font-weight="bold" fill="#FE3675">Messages</text>
  </g>

  <!-- Likes -->
  <g>
    <circle cx="273" cy="790" r="10" fill="none" stroke="#939393" stroke-width="2"/>
    <polygon points="273,784 275,789 280,789 276,792 278,797 273,794 268,797 270,792 266,789 271,789" fill="#939393"/>
    <text x="273" y="824" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Gotham, sans-serif" font-size="10" fill="#939393">Likes</text>
  </g>

  <!-- Profile -->
  <g>
    <circle cx="345" cy="786" r="5" fill="none" stroke="#939393" stroke-width="2"/>
    <ellipse cx="345" cy="798" rx="10" ry="5" fill="none" stroke="#939393" stroke-width="2"/>
    <text x="345" y="824" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Gotham, sans-serif" font-size="10" fill="#939393">Profile</text>
  </g>

  <!-- Home indicator -->
  <rect x="143" y="834" width="104" height="4" rx="2" fill="#000000"/>
</svg>
